remarks: End Unit **HEAT & HOT WATER INCLUDED**Convenience & sophisticated style is what you get with this beautiful 2 bedroom perfectly located to just about everything this city has to offer. Close to 95 and Merritt Parkway and train station. Walk to new SONO Mall, restaurants, parks, and more! Storage available included in the rent and additional laundry facilities. This unit is not to be missed. Parking space #15
